name: Lori Smallwood
prior_offices: Big Horn County clerk (won the November 2022 general election and was re-elected in 2026; listed on the official elections page)
background: Lori Smallwood is the Big Horn County clerk and was re-elected in the November 2026 general election. The official elections page lists her as clerk. The Lovell Chronicle reported that she ran unopposed after winning the Republican primary, and that she swore in Jason Beal as interim sheriff and Cozette Winters as assessor.
